title: Sign-in, passwords & accounts
blurb: Forgotten passwords, locked accounts, two-step sign-in, Windows Hello and Touch ID.

remedies.title: "Your password has expired" or "must be changed"
remedies.why: Your workplace requires a new password periodically or after a reset.

steps.text: Follow the prompt to choose a new one (often it can't match recent ones).
Working remotely? Connect the VPN first, then press Ctrl+Alt+Delete › Change a password, so the PC learns it.
Change it at your organisation's sign-in page (e.g. mysignins.microsoft.com) if the computer won't.
Then update it on your phone.

remedies.title: Use a password manager
remedies.why: A password manager lets you use a different strong password for every site.

steps.text: Use the one built into your browser or system (Google Password Manager, Microsoft Edge, Apple Passwords) or a dedicated one (Bitwarden, 1Password).
Protect it with a long passphrase and two-step sign-in.
Never put work passwords in a personal manager if your workplace has its own.

remedies.title: What is a passkey, and how do I use one?
remedies.why: A passkey replaces a password with your fingerprint, face or PIN, and can't be phished.

steps.text: When a site offers "Create a passkey", accept; Windows Hello or Touch ID protects it.
Passkeys sync through your Apple/Google/Microsoft account or password manager.
Keep a recovery method (password or second device) in case.

remedies.title: Can't sign in to Windows ("password incorrect" or "no logon servers")
remedies.why: A wrong keyboard layout, a changed password not yet known to the PC, or a damaged profile.

steps.text: Check the keyboard layout shown at the bottom right of the sign-in screen, and Caps Lock.
Try your PIN or the other sign-in options.
Work PCs off the network may still accept your previous password.
"Trust relationship failed" or "profile service failed" need IT.

remedies.escalate: IT needs to repair the computer's link to the domain or your profile.

remedies.title: Apple Account locked or keeps asking for the password
remedies.why: Too many wrong tries locks it for security; a changed password needs entering on every device.

steps.text: Unlock at iforgot.apple.com.
Re-enter the new password in System Settings › your name.
Sign out and in again if the prompts continue.

remedies.title: Recover a personal Microsoft account (Outlook.com, Hotmail, Xbox)
remedies.why: Microsoft verifies you by email, phone or a recovery form.

steps.text: Go to account.live.com/password/reset (or /acsr for the recovery form if you can't get codes).
Fill the recovery form from a device and place you've used before, with as many details as you can.
Afterwards add a recovery phone, email and two-step sign-in.

remedies.title: Signing into work apps asks to let my organisation manage this device
symptoms: allow my organization to manage my device
remedies.why: Office and Teams offer to register your PC with your workplace; that gives them some control.

steps.text: On a personal PC, choose "No, sign in to this app only" if you don't want the device managed.
If your workplace requires it, use Company Portal as IT instructs.
See and remove work accounts in Access work or school.

remedies.escalate: Ask IT what's required before enrolling a personal device.
